# DRIFT

DRIFT is a revenue monitoring product for operators. It catches meaningful
revenue movement before it compounds and sends clear signals when something
needs attention.

Primary URL: https://drifthq.co
Pricing URL: https://drifthq.co/pricing
Demo URL: https://drifthq.co/demo
Contact: hello@drifthq.co

Positioning:
- Revenue monitoring and anomaly detection for operators.
- Built for multi-location operators who need early warning across revenue streams.
- Weekly operator briefings instead of dashboard digging.
- 30 days free, then $299/month for the first 12 months during the founding cohort.
- Stripe, Google Sheets, and CSV are supported at launch.
- QuickBooks support is in verification with Intuit.
